title: Specialty Transition Supply under the Formulary Benefit: Scope and Recording Tool
content:
**Scope.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a specialty transition supply is the temporary supply of a non-formulary specialty drug that the specialty pharmacy dispenses to a member inside the member's transition window. The days supply it carries is worked out from the member's specialty records. Once the supply is recorded, the member's transition-fill history shows it as a transition fill dated that day, with the specialty dispensing channel and that days supply, and the pharmacy dispenses that many days.

## Recording tool: `record_specialty_transition_supply_d4f54566`

**What it does.** One call adds one transition fill to the member's transition-fill history under the formulary assignment. The fill is dated today, carries the specialty channel and the days supply given, and appears whenever the member's transition fills are looked up. The tool performs this single write. It does not check eligibility or the value it is given.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `record_specialty_transition_supply_d4f54566` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `formulary_assignment_id` | reference number of the member's formulary assignment, as read from the formulary assignment lookup for the member | identifier |
| `drug_name` | the drug | exactly one drug master list name: atorvastatin, lisinopril, metformin, sertraline, levothyroxine, sumatriptan, oxycodone-acetaminophen, insulin glargine-yfgn, Lantus, Eliquis, Xarelto, Jardiance, Ozempic, Mounjaro, Wegovy, Zepbound, Trelegy Ellipta, Breztri Aerosphere, Nurtec ODT, Ubrelvy, Humira, adalimumab-adaz, Dupixent, Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Enbrel, Biktarvy, Ibrance |
| `drug_strength` | the strength and dosage form, copied character for character from the strength shown on the member's latest specialty fill of the drug | verbatim text, with no change to wording, digits or punctuation |
| `transition_basis` | why the member is in a transition window: `new_enrollment` (the assignment has no formulary change date, so the window runs from the coverage effective date) or `formulary_change` (the assignment carries a formulary change date because the sponsor moved the member to this formulary) | enum |
| `days_supply` | the days supply dispensed | whole number of days, no decimals; stored exactly as given |

The presence of a parameter means only that the value is needed at call time.

**Return.** On success the tool returns a receipt with:
- `formulary_transition_fill_id`, the reference number of the new transition fill;
- `drug_name`;
- `fill_date`, today's date of service as YYYY-MM-DD;
- `days_supply`, a whole number;
- `dispensing_channel`, which is always specialty for this tool;
- status "recorded".

A receipt with status "recorded" means the supply was recorded. The tool defines no other outcome.
